-- =============================================
-- Author:        Monir
-- Create date:   8-8-2019
-- Description:   Authenticate a center user.
--
-- Modified by:   Osama Saad
-- Modified date: 9-5-2025
-- Modification:  - Fixed password validation to use the correct '[SQL literal withheld]' column.
--                - Changed procedure to return a standard result set instead of using OUTPUT parameters.
--                - Simplified validation to align with modern NestJS service requirements.
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[authenticateCenterUser]
    @userName   NVARCHAR(450),
    @password   NVARCHAR(450)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @ID INT;
    
    -- Find the user ID where the username matches and the hashed password is valid
    SELECT @ID = ID
    FROM [dbo].[Center_Users] WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE 
        username = @userName 
        AND user_password = [dbo].[getHashedPassword](@password, password_salt);

    -- If a user was found, and they are active, return their data
    IF @ID IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT is_active FROM dbo.Center_Users WHERE ID = @ID) = 1
    BEGIN
        -- Success: Return the user's full data
        SELECT ID, username, is_admin, center_id, center_type
        FROM [dbo].[Center_Users]
        WHERE ID = @ID;
    END
END

name: authenticateChildUser
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 8-8-2019
-- Description:	Validate child user
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[authenticateChildUser]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	 @username				NVARCHAR(500)
	,@password				NVARCHAR(500)
	,@authenticationStatus	INT = 0		OUTPUT
	,@userID				NVARCHAR(450) = ''	OUTPUT
	,@centerID				INT			  = -1	OUTPUT
	,@centerType			INT			  = -1	OUTPUT
	,@accessToken			NVARCHAR(500) = NULL	OUTPUT

AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @ID INT 
	SELECT @ID = [dbo].[Child_Users].ID, @centerID = center_id, @centerType = center_type 
	FROM [dbo].[Child_Users] WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE username = @username AND user_password = @password AND is_active = 1

	IF @ID IS NOT NULL AND @centerType > 0
		BEGIN

			DECLARE @isUserValid BIT = 0

			-- Check if this parent is found
			IF @centerType = 4 
				BEGIN 
					IF EXISTS ( 
						SELECT 1 FROM [icare_secure].[dbo].[Child_Users]  users WITH (NOLOCK)
							INNER JOIN [icare_school].[dbo].[Child]			children	ON children.child_id = users.child_id		AND ISNULL(children.deleted,0) <> 1
							INNER JOIN [icare_school].[dbo].[Parent]		parents     ON children.parent_id = parents.parent_id	AND ISNULL(parents.deleted,0) <> 1
							INNER JOIN [icare_school].[dbo].[Care_Center]	centers		ON parents.center_id  = centers.center_id	AND users.center_type = centers.[type]
						WHERE   users.ID = @ID AND users.center_type = 4
						)
						SELECT @isUserValid = 1
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF EXISTS ( 
						SELECT 1 FROM [icare_secure].[dbo].[Child_Users] users  WITH (NOLOCK)
							INNER JOIN [icare].[dbo].[Child]			 children   ON children.child_id  = users.child_id		AND ISNULL(children.deleted,0) <> 1
							INNER JOIN [icare].[dbo].[Parent]			 parents    ON children.parent_id = parents.parent_id	AND ISNULL(parents.deleted,0) <> 1
							INNER JOIN [icare].[dbo].[Care_Center]		 centers	ON parents.center_id  = centers.center_id   AND centers.[type]	= users.center_type  
						WHERE   users.ID = @ID AND users.center_type <> 4
						)
						SELECT @isUserValid = 1
				END

			IF @isUserValid = 1
				BEGIN
					IF [dbo].[isCenterActive](@centerID, @centerType) = 1
						BEGIN 
							SELECT @authenticationStatus =1,@centerID = center_id,@centerType = center_type, @userID = child_id ,@accessToken = access_token
							FROM [dbo].[Child_Users] WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE ID = @ID
						END
					ELSE
						SELECT @authenticationStatus = 3  -- Locked center account
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					SELECT @authenticationStatus = -1
				END
		END
	ELSE SET @authenticationStatus = -1  -- unauthorized user

END

-- =============================================

-- Create date: 9-17-2019
-- Description:	Authenticate iCare Dealer
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[authenticateDealer]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	 @userName NVARCHAR(450)
    ,@password NVARCHAR(450)
	,@dealerID				INT = -1	OUTPUT
	,@isAdmin				BIT = -1	OUTPUT
	,@authenticationStatus	INT = 0		OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @ID INT 
	SELECT  @ID = dealer_id FROM [dbo].Dealers WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE username=@userName AND user_password = dbo.getHashedPassword(@password,password_salt) AND is_active = 1

    IF @ID IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN
			SELECT @authenticationStatus = 1,@dealerID = dealer_id,@isAdmin = is_super_admin
			FROM [dbo].[Dealers] WITH (NOLOCK) 
			WHERE dealer_id = @ID
		END
    ELSE SET @authenticationStatus = -1  -- unauthorized user

END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 8-14-2019
-- Description:	Authenticate provider user
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[authenticateProviderUser]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	 @username				NVARCHAR(500)
	,@password				NVARCHAR(500)
	,@authenticationStatus	INT = 0		OUTPUT
	,@userID				INT = -1	OUTPUT
	,@centerID				INT = -1	OUTPUT
	,@centerType			INT = -1	OUTPUT
	,@accessToken			NVARCHAR(500) = NULL	OUTPUT

AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @ID INT 
	SELECT @ID = dbo.Provider_Users.ID, @centerID = center_id, @centerType = center_type  
	FROM  [dbo].[Provider_Users] WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE username = @username AND user_password = @password AND is_active = 1

	IF @ID IS NOT NULL AND @centerType > 0
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @isUserValid BIT 
			
			-- Check if this provider is found
			IF @centerType = 4 
				BEGIN 
					IF EXISTS ( 
						SELECT 1 FROM  [icare_secure].[dbo].[Provider_Users] users WITH (NOLOCK)
							INNER JOIN [icare_school].[dbo].[provider]		 providers	ON providers.provider_id	= users.provider_id AND ISNULL(providers.deleted,0) <> 1
							INNER JOIN [icare_school].[dbo].[Care_Center]	 centers	ON providers.center_id		= centers.center_id	AND users.center_type = centers.[type]
						WHERE users.ID = @ID AND users.center_type = 4
						)
						SELECT @isUserValid = 1
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF EXISTS ( 
						SELECT 1 FROM [icare_secure].[dbo].[Provider_Users]  users WITH (NOLOCK)
							INNER JOIN [icare].[dbo].[provider]		providers	ON providers.provider_id = users.provider_id AND ISNULL(providers.deleted,0) <> 1
							INNER JOIN [icare].[dbo].[Care_Center]  centers		ON providers.center_id	 = centers.center_id	AND centers.[type]	= users.center_type  
						WHERE users.ID = @ID AND users.center_type <> 4
						)
						SELECT @isUserValid = 1
				END
				
			-- Check if the user is valid, validate the center activity 
			-- These two processes are seperated in order to send distinct response flag accordingly (invalid, inactive)..
			IF @isUserValid = 1
				BEGIN
					IF [dbo].[isCenterActive](@centerID, @centerType) = 1
						BEGIN 
							SELECT @authenticationStatus =1,@centerID = center_id,@centerType = center_type, @userID = provider_id ,@accessToken = access_token
							FROM [dbo].[Provider_Users] WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE ID = @ID
						END
					ELSE
						SELECT @authenticationStatus = 3  -- Locked center account
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					SELECT @authenticationStatus = -1
				END
		END
	ELSE SELECT @authenticationStatus = -1  -- unauthorized user

END

name: dealerHasAccess
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 9-1-2020
-- Description:	Check if a selected dealer has the ability to modify a center data
--				User is authorized if the center is under his package or if he is a supre admin
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[dealerHasAccess]
(
	 @dealerID		INT
	,@centerID		INT
	,@centerType	INT
)
RETURNS BIT
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @hasAccess BIT = 0

	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Dealer_Centers 
				WHERE center_id = @centerID AND center_type = @centerType AND dealer_id = @dealerID)
		SELECT @hasAccess = 1;
	ELSE IF dbo.isDealerSuperAdmin(@dealerID) = 1
		SELECT @hasAccess = 1;

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @hasAccess

END

name: getHashedPassword
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 8-8-2019
-- Description:	Get hashed password
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[getHashedPassword]
(
	@password NVARCHAR(450),@SALT UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
)
RETURNS BINARY (64)
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @hasedPassword AS BINARY(64)
	
	SELECT @hasedPassword = HASHBYTES('SHA2_512', @password+CAST(@SALT AS NVARCHAR(36)))
	-- Return the result of the function

	RETURN @hasedPassword
END

name: getKeyText
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 1-18-2021
-- Description:	Get the key as plain text for the selected key identifier as requested by the user
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[getKeyText]
(
	@keyIdentifier NVARCHAR(200)
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @enkryptedKey VARBINARY(200) ,@passPhrase NVARCHAR(200)
	SELECT @enkryptedKey = key_value,@passPhrase = pass_phrase FROM [dbo].[Keys] WHERE key_identifier = @keyIdentifier
	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN CONVERT(VARCHAR(200),DECRYPTBYPASSPHRASE(@passPhrase, @enkryptedKey ))

END

-- =============================================

-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_getCentersCowPayApiSettings]
	 @dealerID			INT 
	,@filterDealerID	INT
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @isAdmin BIT 
	SELECT @isAdmin = is_super_admin FROM dbo.Dealers WHERE dealer_id = @dealerID

	IF @isAdmin = 1
		BEGIN
			SELECT dealerCenters.dealer_id,dealerCenters.dealer_name,dealerCenters.center_id,center_name,dealerCenters.center_type
				,CASE WHEN cowPaySettings.ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END is_configured
				,ISNULL(cowPaySettings.is_enabled,0) is_enabled  
				,[dbo].[getCenterQualifierString](dealerCenters.center_id,dealerCenters.center_type) AS  center_qualifier
			FROM [dbo].[vwDealerCenters]  dealerCenters
				LEFT JOIN [icare].[dbo].[Cowpay_Center_Api_Settings] cowPaySettings ON  dealerCenters.center_id = cowPaySettings.center_id AND dealerCenters.center_type  <> 4
			WHERE dealerCenters.center_type  <> 4  AND (dealerCenters.dealer_id = @filterDealerID OR @filterDealerID = -1)

			--	,[dbo].[getCenterQualifierString](dealerCenters.center_id,dealerCenters.center_type) AS  center_qualifier

				,ISNULL(cowPaySettings.is_enabled,0) is_enabled  
				,[dbo].[getCenterQualifierString](dealerCenters.center_id,dealerCenters.center_type) AS  center_qualifier
			FROM [dbo].[vwDealerCenters]  dealerCenters
				LEFT JOIN [icare].[dbo].[Cowpay_Center_Api_Settings] cowPaySettings ON  dealerCenters.center_id = cowPaySettings.center_id AND dealerCenters.center_type  <> 4
			WHERE dealerCenters.center_type  <> 4  AND (dealerCenters.dealer_id = @dealerID)

			--	LEFT JOIN [icare_school].[dbo].[Cowpay_Center_Api_Settings] cowPaySettings ON  dealerCenters.center_id = cowPaySettings.center_id AND dealerCenters.center_type  = 4

name: iCareAdmin_getCenterStatusesList
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 2-1-2021
-- Description:	Get the centers statuses list per dealer
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_getCenterStatusesList]
	 @dealerID INT
	,@filterDealerID INT
	,@filterStatusID INT
	
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @defaultStatus INT = 1

	DECLARE @isAdmin BIT = [dbo].[isDealerSuperAdmin](@dealerID)  

	IF @isAdmin = 1
		BEGIN
			SELECT dealerCenters.center_id,center_name,dealerCenters.center_type,dealer_id,dealer_name
				,CONCAT(dealerCenters.center_id,'_',dealerCenters.center_type) center_qualifier 
				,ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,@defaultStatus)  activation_status
				,statusesRef.status_title
			FROM [dbo].[vwDealerCenters] dealerCenters
				LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Center_Status] centerStatus 
						ON dealerCenters.center_id = centerStatus.center_id AND dealerCenters.center_type = centerStatus.center_type
				LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Center_Status_Reference] statusesRef 
						ON ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,@defaultStatus) = statusesRef.status_id
			WHERE (@filterDealerID = -1 OR dealer_id = @filterDealerID) 
				AND (ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,@defaultStatus) = @filterStatusID OR @filterStatusID = -1)
			ORDER BY center_name
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @pageID INT = 9

			-- Dealer Centers
			SELECT dealerCenters.center_id,center_name,dealerCenters.center_type,dealer_id,dealer_name
				,CONCAT(dealerCenters.center_id,'_',dealerCenters.center_type) center_qualifier 
				,ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,@defaultStatus)  activation_status
				,statusesRef.status_title
			FROM [dbo].[vwDealerCenters] dealerCenters
				LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Center_Status] centerStatus 
						ON dealerCenters.center_id = centerStatus.center_id AND dealerCenters.center_type = centerStatus.center_type
				LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Center_Status_Reference] statusesRef 
						ON ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,@defaultStatus) = statusesRef.status_id
			WHERE dealer_id = @dealerID	  
				AND (ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,@defaultStatus) = @filterStatusID OR @filterStatusID = -1)
			UNION
			-- Get the list of centers the selected dealer has special access to and are not under his account
			SELECT dealerCenters.center_id,center_name,dealerCenters.center_type,dealerCenters.dealer_id,'[SQL literal withheld]'  dealer_name
				,CONCAT(dealerCenters.center_id,'_',dealerCenters.center_type) center_qualifier 
				,ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,@defaultStatus)  activation_status
				,statusesRef.status_title
			FROM [dbo].[vwDealerCenters] dealerCenters
				INNER JOIN [dbo].[Dealer_Page_Center_Access] pageAccess 
					ON pageAccess.center_id = dealerCenters.center_id AND pageAccess.center_type = dealerCenters.center_type
					AND pageAccess.page_id = @pageID AND pageAccess.dealer_id = @dealerID
				LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Center_Status] centerStatus 
						ON dealerCenters.center_id = centerStatus.center_id AND dealerCenters.center_type = centerStatus.center_type
				LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Center_Status_Reference] statusesRef 
						ON ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,@defaultStatus) = statusesRef.status_id
			WHERE dealerCenters.dealer_id <> @dealerID	
				AND (ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,@defaultStatus) = @filterStatusID OR @filterStatusID = -1)
			ORDER BY center_name
		END
	
END

-- =============================================

-- Description:	Get the dealer list of center messages

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_getDealerCentersAlertMessage]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
		 @dealerID INT
		,@filterDealerID INT
		,@filterStatusID INT = 1 -- By Default get only active centers 
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @isAdmin BIT 
	SELECT @isAdmin = is_super_admin FROM dbo.Dealers WHERE dealer_id = @dealerID
	
	IF @isAdmin = 1 
		BEGIN
			SELECT DISTINCT dealerCenters.dealer_id,dealerCenters.dealer_name,dealerCenters.center_id,center_name,dealerCenters.center_type,message_text,FORMAT(alert_expiry_date,'MM/dd/yyyy') alert_expiry_date
				,[dbo].[getCenterQualifierString](dealerCenters.center_id,dealerCenters.center_type) AS  center_qualifier
				,ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,1) AS activation_status
			FROM [dbo].[vwDealerCenters]  dealerCenters
					LEFT JOIN [icare].[dbo].[Center_Alert_Message] centerMessage ON  dealerCenters.center_id = centerMessage.center_id AND dealerCenters.center_type  <> 4
					LEFT JOIN [icare_secure].[dbo].[Center_Status] centerStatus  ON  dealerCenters.center_id = centerStatus.center_id  AND dealerCenters.center_type = centerStatus.center_type
			WHERE dealerCenters.center_type  <> 4  AND (dealerCenters.dealer_id = @filterDealerID OR @filterDealerID = -1)
				AND (ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,1) = @filterStatusID OR @filterStatusID = -1)
			UNION
			SELECT DISTINCT dealerCenters.dealer_id,dealerCenters.dealer_name,dealerCenters.center_id,center_name,dealerCenters.center_type,message_text,FORMAT(alert_expiry_date,'MM/dd/yyyy') alert_expiry_date
				,[dbo].[getCenterQualifierString](dealerCenters.center_id,dealerCenters.center_type) center_qualifier 
				,ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,1) AS activation_status
			FROM [dbo].[vwDealerCenters]  dealerCenters
					LEFT JOIN [icare_school].[dbo].[Center_Alert_Message] centerMessage ON  dealerCenters.center_id = centerMessage.center_id AND dealerCenters.center_type  = 4
					LEFT JOIN [icare_secure].[dbo].[Center_Status]		  centerStatus  ON  dealerCenters.center_id = centerStatus.center_id     AND dealerCenters.center_type = centerStatus.center_type
			WHERE dealerCenters.center_type  = 4 AND (dealerCenters.dealer_id = @filterDealerID OR @filterDealerID = -1)
				AND (ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,1) = @filterStatusID OR @filterStatusID = -1)
			ORDER BY center_name
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN

			DECLARE @pageID INT = 8

			SELECT DISTINCT dealerCenters.dealer_id,dealerCenters.dealer_name,dealerCenters.center_id,center_name,dealerCenters.center_type,message_text,FORMAT(alert_expiry_date,'MM/dd/yyyy') alert_expiry_date
				,[dbo].[getCenterQualifierString](dealerCenters.center_id,dealerCenters.center_type) center_qualifier 
				,ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,1) AS activation_status
			FROM [dbo].[vwDealerCenters]  dealerCenters
					LEFT JOIN [icare].[dbo].[Center_Alert_Message] centerMessage ON  dealerCenters.center_id = centerMessage.center_id AND dealerCenters.center_type  <> 4
					LEFT JOIN [icare_secure].[dbo].[Center_Status] centerStatus  ON  dealerCenters.center_id = centerStatus.center_id  AND dealerCenters.center_type = centerStatus.center_type
			WHERE dealerCenters.center_type  <> 4 AND dealerCenters.dealer_id = @dealerID
				AND (ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,1) = @filterStatusID OR @filterStatusID = -1)
			UNION
			SELECT DISTINCT dealerCenters.dealer_id,dealerCenters.dealer_name,dealerCenters.center_id,center_name,dealerCenters.center_type,message_text,FORMAT(alert_expiry_date,'MM/dd/yyyy') alert_expiry_date
				,[dbo].[getCenterQualifierString](dealerCenters.center_id,dealerCenters.center_type) center_qualifier 
				,ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,1) AS activation_status
			FROM [dbo].[vwDealerCenters]  dealerCenters
					LEFT JOIN [icare_school].[dbo].[Center_Alert_Message] centerMessage ON  dealerCenters.center_id = centerMessage.center_id AND dealerCenters.center_type  = 4
					LEFT JOIN [icare_secure].[dbo].[Center_Status]		  centerStatus  ON  dealerCenters.center_id = centerStatus.center_id     AND dealerCenters.center_type = centerStatus.center_type
			WHERE dealerCenters.center_type  = 4 AND dealerCenters.dealer_id = @dealerID
				AND (ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,1) = @filterStatusID OR @filterStatusID = -1)
			UNION
			-- Get the list of centers the selected dealer has special access to and are not under his account
			SELECT DISTINCT dealerCenters.dealer_id,'[SQL literal withheld]' dealer_name,dealerCenters.center_id,center_name,dealerCenters.center_type,message_text,FORMAT(alert_expiry_date,'MM/dd/yyyy') alert_expiry_date
				,[dbo].[getCenterQualifierString](dealerCenters.center_id,dealerCenters.center_type) center_qualifier 
				,ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,1) AS activation_status
			FROM [dbo].[vwDealerCenters]  dealerCenters
					INNER JOIN [dbo].[Dealer_Page_Center_Access] pageAccess 
						ON pageAccess.center_id = dealerCenters.center_id AND pageAccess.center_type = dealerCenters.center_type
																		  AND pageAccess.page_id	 = @pageID 
																		  AND pageAccess.dealer_id	 = @dealerID
					LEFT JOIN [icare].[dbo].[Center_Alert_Message] centerMessage ON  dealerCenters.center_id = centerMessage.center_id AND dealerCenters.center_type  <> 4
					LEFT JOIN [icare_secure].[dbo].[Center_Status] centerStatus  ON  dealerCenters.center_id = centerStatus.center_id  AND dealerCenters.center_type = centerStatus.center_type
			WHERE dealerCenters.dealer_id <> @dealerID AND dealerCenters.center_type  <> 4
				AND (ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,1) = @filterStatusID OR @filterStatusID = -1)
			UNION
			SELECT DISTINCT dealerCenters.dealer_id,'[SQL literal withheld]' dealer_name,dealerCenters.center_id,center_name,dealerCenters.center_type,message_text,FORMAT(alert_expiry_date,'MM/dd/yyyy') alert_expiry_date
				,[dbo].[getCenterQualifierString](dealerCenters.center_id,dealerCenters.center_type) center_qualifier 
				,ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,1) AS activation_status
			FROM [dbo].[vwDealerCenters]  dealerCenters
					INNER JOIN [dbo].[Dealer_Page_Center_Access] pageAccess 
						ON pageAccess.center_id = dealerCenters.center_id AND pageAccess.center_type = dealerCenters.center_type
																		  AND pageAccess.page_id	 = @pageID 
																		  AND pageAccess.dealer_id	 = @dealerID
					LEFT JOIN [icare_school].[dbo].[Center_Alert_Message] centerMessage ON  dealerCenters.center_id = centerMessage.center_id AND dealerCenters.center_type  = 4
					LEFT JOIN [icare_secure].[dbo].[Center_Status]		  centerStatus  ON  dealerCenters.center_id = centerStatus.center_id     AND dealerCenters.center_type = centerStatus.center_type
			WHERE dealerCenters.dealer_id <> @dealerID AND dealerCenters.center_type  = 4
				AND (ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,1) = @filterStatusID OR @filterStatusID = -1)
			ORDER BY center_name
			
		END
    
END

name: iCareAdmin_updateCenterActivationStatus

-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 2-1-2021
-- Description:	Update center activation status
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_updateCenterActivationStatus]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	 @dealerID			INT
	,@centerID			INT
	,@centerType		INT
	,@activationStatus	INT
	,@updateStatus 		INT = 0 OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	DECLARE @errorText NVARCHAR(MAX);
	IF [dbo].isDealerSuperAdmin(@dealerID) = 1 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[Dealer_Centers] WHERE dealer_id = @dealerID AND center_id = @centerID AND center_type = @centerType)
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[Center_Status] WHERE center_id = @centerID AND center_type = @centerType) 
				BEGIN
					UPDATE [dbo].Center_Status SET activation_status = @activationStatus,update_time = GETUTCDATE()
					WHERE center_id = @centerID AND center_type = @centerType
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO [dbo].[Center_Status] (center_id,center_type,activation_status,update_time)
					VALUES(@centerID,@centerType,@activationStatus,GETUTCDATE())
				END
			SELECT @updateStatus = 1
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT @errorText = '[SQL literal withheld]'
			SELECT @updateStatus = -1 -- Unauthorized
		END

	EXEC [icare_log].[dbo].[record_CenterActivationStatusUpdates] @centerID,@centerType,@dealerID,@activationStatus,@updateStatus,@errorText;
	
END

name: iCareAdmin_updateDealer
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 9-19-2019
-- Description:	Update
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_updateDealer]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	 @dealerID		INT = 0
	,@username		NVARCHAR(450)
	,@dealerName	NVARCHAR(450)
	,@password		NVARCHAR(450)
	,@email			NVARCHAR(450)
	,@isAdmin		BIT
	,@isActive		BIT
	,@insertedID	INT = 0 OUTPUT
	,@updateStatus	INT = 0 OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	IF @dealerID IS NULL OR @dealerID <= 0 
		BEGIN
			
			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Dealers WHERE username = @username)
				BEGIN
					DECLARE @salt UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NEWID()

					INSERT INTO dbo.Dealers(dealer_name,username,user_password,password_salt,user_email,is_super_admin,is_active)
					VALUES (@dealerName,@username,dbo.getHashedPassword(@password,@salt),@salt,@email,@isAdmin,@isActive)
					
					SELECT @insertedID = CONVERT(INT,SCOPE_IDENTITY())

					-- User added successfully
					SELECT @updateStatus = 1
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					-- Conflict username already found
					SELECT @updateStatus = -5
				END
			END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			UPDATE dbo.Dealers SET dealer_name = @dealerName
					,user_password	= dbo.getHashedPassword(@password,password_salt)
					,user_email		= @email
					,is_active		= @isActive
					,is_super_admin = @isAdmin
			WHERE dealer_id = @dealerID

			SELECT @insertedID = @dealerID
			
			-- User updated successfully
			SELECT @updateStatus = 1
		END

		

END

-- =============================================

-- Create date: 10-3-2019
-- Description:	This is  a temp procedure to add the clear password in centers users table
--				This is temporary in order to keep the ability of getting passwords using the iCare Keys
--				This is called from the updateUserPassword procedure. When it should be deleted make sure
--				you remove its call from there.

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Temp_updateLocalCenterUserPassword]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	 @userName NVARCHAR(450)
	,@userPassword NVARCHAR(450)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.

END

name: updateUserPassword
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 8-8-2019
-- Description:	Update users password.
--				for now applicable for admins, parents, and providers
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[updateUserPassword]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	 @userName	   NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@oldPassword  NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@newPassowrd  NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@userType	   INT
	,@isAdmin	   BIT = 0 
	,@updateStatus INT = 0 OUTPUT
	,@responseMessage NVARCHAR(250) = '' OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	--=== Care Center Admin user
	IF @userType = 1
		BEGIN
			-- Get the user password salt to be used for checking and hashing new password
			-- And retrieving it checks if the user is valid or not 
			DECLARE @salt UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
			SELECT @salt = dbo.Center_Users.password_salt FROM dbo.Center_Users  WHERE username = @userName 

			IF @salt IS NOT NULL
				BEGIN
					-- Has the passed password in order to check validity
					DECLARE @hasedPassword BINARY (64) = dbo.getHashedPassword(@oldPassword,@salt)
					-- if isAdmin is changing this then allow even if old password not supplied
					IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Center_Users WHERE username = @userName AND (@isAdmin = 1 OR user_password = @hasedPassword))
						BEGIN
							UPDATE dbo.Center_Users SET user_password = dbo.getHashedPassword(@newPassowrd ,@salt) WHERE username = @userName 
							-- TEMP CALL: SAVE clear text password in users tables
							EXEC [dbo].[Temp_updateLocalCenterUserPassword] @userName,@newPassowrd

							SELECT @updateStatus = 1,@responseMessage = '[SQL literal withheld]'
						END
					ELSE
						SELECT @updateStatus = -1,@responseMessage = '[SQL literal withheld]'
				END
			ELSE
				SELECT @updateStatus = 0,@responseMessage = '[SQL literal withheld]'
		END
	--=== Parent user
	ELSE IF @userType = 2
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Parent_Users WHERE username = @userName AND user_password = @oldPassword)
				BEGIN
					UPDATE dbo.Parent_Users SET user_password = @newPassowrd  WHERE username = @userName AND user_password = @oldPassword
					SELECT @updateStatus = 1,@responseMessage = '[SQL literal withheld]'
				END
			ELSE
				SELECT @updateStatus = -1,@responseMessage = '[SQL literal withheld]'
		END
	--=== Provider user
	ELSE IF @userType  = 3
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Provider_Users WHERE username = @userName AND user_password = @oldPassword)
				BEGIN
					UPDATE dbo.Provider_Users SET user_password = @newPassowrd  WHERE username = @userName AND user_password = @oldPassword
					SELECT @updateStatus = 1,@responseMessage = '[SQL literal withheld]'
				END
			ELSE
				SELECT @updateStatus = -1,@responseMessage = '[SQL literal withheld]'
		END
		--=== Child user
	ELSE IF @userType  = 4
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Child_Users WHERE username = @userName AND user_password = @oldPassword)
				BEGIN
					UPDATE dbo.Child_Users SET user_password = @newPassowrd  WHERE username = @userName AND user_password = @oldPassword
					SELECT @updateStatus = 1,@responseMessage = '[SQL literal withheld]'
				END
			ELSE
				SELECT @updateStatus = -1,@responseMessage = '[SQL literal withheld]'
		END
	ELSE
		SELECT @updateStatus = -1,@responseMessage = '[SQL literal withheld]'


	EXECUTE  [icare_log].[dbo].[record_userPasswordUpdate] @userName,@oldPassword,@newPassowrd,@userType,@isAdmin,@updateStatus,@responseMessage

END

name: utils_buildUsername
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 8-26-2019
-- Description:	Build username based on the center and user types 
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[utils_buildUsername]
	 @centerType INT
	,@centerID	 INT
	,@userType	 INT
	,@username	 NVARCHAR(450) = '' OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @prefUserType	CHAR(1) =  CASE WHEN @userType = 1 THEN '[SQL literal withheld]' WHEN @userType = 2  THEN '[SQL literal withheld]' WHEN @userType = 3 THEN '[SQL literal withheld]' WHEN @userType = 4 THEN '[SQL literal withheld]' ELSE '' END
	DECLARE @prefCenterType	CHAR(1) =  CASE WHEN @centerType = 4 THEN '[SQL literal withheld]' ELSE '[SQL literal withheld]' END
	
	-- Get the user center users counter
	DECLARE @usersCounter INT 
	EXEC	@usersCounter = [dbo].[utils_getCenterUserNextNumber] @centerID = @centerID,@centerType = @centerType,@userType = @userType

	-- Get the final formatted username 
	SELECT @username = CONCAT(@prefUserType,@prefCenterType,@centerID,'[SQL literal withheld]',@usersCounter)
	
END

name: utils_getCenterUserNextNumber
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 8-26-2019
-- Description:	Get the latest user counter for a center 
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[utils_getCenterUserNextNumber]
	 @centerID		INT
	,@centerType	INT
	,@userType	    INT
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @counter INT
	SELECT @counter  = user_counter FROM dbo.Center_Users_Counter WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE center_id = @centerID AND center_type = @centerType AND user_type = @userType

	IF @counter  IS NULL 
		BEGIN 
			SELECT @counter = 0
			INSERT INTO dbo.Center_Users_Counter (center_id,center_type ,user_counter,user_type)
			VALUES (@centerID,@centerType,@counter,@userType)			
		END
	
	SELECT @counter = (@counter + 1)

	RETURN @counter
    
END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vwCenterUsers]
AS
SELECT users.ID,users.center_user_id,users.username,centers.center_id,users.center_type,center_name,users.is_admin
		,usersInfo.Firstname,usersInfo.Lastname,usersInfo.Email
FROM [icare_secure].[dbo].[Center_Users] users

		INNER JOIN  [icare].[dbo].[sec_users]	usersInfo ON users.center_user_id = usersInfo.ID
UNION
SELECT users.ID,users.center_user_id,users.username,centers.center_id,users.center_type,center_name,users.is_admin
		,usersInfo.Firstname,usersInfo.Lastname,usersInfo.Email
FROM [icare_secure].[dbo].[Center_Users] users  
		INNER JOIN  [icare_school].[dbo].[Care_Center]	centers		ON users.center_id		= centers.center_id AND users.center_type = 4
		INNER JOIN  [icare_school].[dbo].[sec_users]	usersInfo	ON users.center_user_id = usersInfo.ID

name: vwDealerCenters
definition:
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vwDealerCenters]
AS
SELECT dealers.dealer_id,Dealers.dealer_name,centers.center_id,center_name,center_logo,center_land_line,center_mobile,center_address,center_location,center_photo,center_email,dealersLink.center_type,centers.creation_date
		,ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,1) is_active,is_demo
		,SUBSTRING(center_location, CHARINDEX(',', center_location) + 1, LEN(center_location)) AS latitude
		,SUBSTRING(center_location, 1, CHARINDEX(',', center_location) - 1) AS longitude
		,currency.currency_name
		,'[SQL literal withheld]' AS center_type_text
FROM  icare.dbo.Care_Center centers
		INNER JOIN [icare_secure].[dbo].[Dealer_Centers]	dealersLink		ON dealersLink.center_id = centers.center_id  AND dealersLink.center_type = centers.type AND centers.type <> 4
		INNER JOIN [icare_secure].[dbo].[Dealers]			dealers			ON dealersLink.dealer_id = dealers.dealer_id
		LEFT  JOIN [icare_secure].[dbo].[Currency]			currency		ON currency.currency_id  = centers.center_currency
		LEFT  JOIN [icare_secure].[dbo].[Center_Status]		centerStatus	ON centerStatus.center_id = centers.center_id AND centerStatus.center_type = centers.[type] AND centers.[type] <> 4
UNION
SELECT dealers.dealer_id,Dealers.dealer_name,centers.center_id,center_name,center_logo,center_land_line,center_mobile,center_address,center_location,center_photo,center_email,dealersLink.center_type,centers.creation_date
	,ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,1) is_active,is_demo
	,SUBSTRING(center_location, CHARINDEX(',', center_location) + 1, LEN(center_location)) AS latitude
	,SUBSTRING(center_location, 1, CHARINDEX(',', center_location) - 1) AS longitude
	,currency.currency_name
	,'[SQL literal withheld]' AS center_type_text
FROM  icare_school.dbo.Care_Center centers
	INNER JOIN [icare_secure].[dbo].[Dealer_Centers] dealersLink	ON dealersLink.center_id = centers.center_id AND dealersLink.center_type = centers.type AND centers.type = 4
	INNER JOIN [icare_secure].[dbo].[Dealers]		 dealers		ON dealersLink.dealer_id = dealers.dealer_id
	LEFT  JOIN [icare_secure].[dbo].[Currency]			currency		ON currency.currency_id  = centers.center_currency
	LEFT  JOIN [icare_secure].[dbo].[Center_Status]	centerStatus	ON centerStatus.center_id = centers.center_id AND centerStatus.center_type = centers.[type] AND centers.[type] = 4
